name: Rikka Stems
desc:
(Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Tribute 2 cards from your hand and/or field, and if you do, add 1 "Rikka" card from your Deck to your hand.
During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was Tributed this turn: You can Special Summon it.
You can only use each effect of "Rikka Stems" once per turn.
strings: Reveal this card to Tribute 2 cards and add 1 "Rikka" card
Special Summon this card from the GY
